The plan was basically to hang up the ribbons, offer the salt, and then just hang out until we would see something out of the ordinary (at least to us).

You know that feeling that you're being watched? Yeah, that's what we had from the start. Things got a whole lot more interesting throughout hanging the ribbons, with the final ribbons being hanged being the climax. I've been trying to put into words what I saw, but it is pretty much indescribable. Never seen anything like it. In a way I wish it were fiction or a dream... At least then I could just make it up to be whatever and that'd be that. I was looking down at the ribbons, and then saw at the top of my field of vision what I thought were two trees with fur or thin branches falling down over them. In the shape of legs. The stocky variety, like what you have on short people or children. As I looked up because I was still trying to process what I was seeing but so far it had registered that I had not had small trees in an odd shape right next to me (think 2 meters), I saw the rest of the body. It seemed unreal. You know how in movies and games when somebody has an invisibility trick or spell, and their body goes to this crystal clear colorless version of their body, before disappearing entirely? That's exactly what happened when I looked at it. I saw the legs looking like the bark of trees, and then the waist had like thin branches or bits of fur around it strapped and hanging down, and the rest of the body was just this strong build of somebody of about a meter and a half, if not smaller. As I realized I was looking at a somebody instead of a tree, I couldn't help but let out a surprised "oh", to which the being turned its upper body towards me like as if it got spooked, and just went on to disappear. I was both excited on seeing it, as well as really disappointed that I couldn't keep my mouth shut. At about the same time, my fiance let me know excitedly that "I see something! It's really interesting", but on asking him later on what it was, he couldn't even recall that he supposedly saw something in the first place. Which was kind of weird, but then again, both pretty much excited on either getting to lay contact with something in the forest, or getting murdered (hey, you never know), but either way things will be interesting.

After a while of us waiting for something to happen, we heard a lot of footsteps, branches cracking as if under feet, and then the ribbons started to move. And not by wind. We had hung them from large tree branches hanging down, and the branches were healthy and full of leaves. They moved when there was even a bit of wind, but this time there was no wind at all. The leaves didn't even rustle. And yet, we saw the ribbons move like they were touched. Not even just a breeze, I really mean touched. Like when you move your hand into a ribbon hanging down, and you can see the ribbon being pushed where your hand meets. Like that. You could see that some ribbons were moved more than others, like they'd all be picked up at the ends, and were softly let out of somebody's hand. No wind. And one by one the ribbons started to move in the sequence they were hung up in.

Then again, for a while, nothing except the footsteps and cracking of branches underneath feet. There were some flying bugs (mosquitoes but bigger. Didn't get a glimpse because of the darkness) which left marks that haven't healed up yet, despite the balm usually removing whatever bites, but that was about that for quite a while.

Later on again, we both got a thought in our minds that was not ours at all. My partner was asked what his purpose was in the forest. He replied by saying that he came in peace and went to be peaceful with nature and whomever else was there. He was told that he was good to remain. I was asked what I was doing in the forest (guess I was the greatest offender seeing I did pretty much all of the work. I replied by saying I came to offer the ribbons and the salt, and to pay my respect to the forest and it's inhabitants. And that was that, until a minute or so after that, I suddenly got the strong urge to look behind me. I think it was about 10 meters or so behind me - at first I thought it was a child, but it stood still and I could just feel it stare at me, like it was trying to figure me all out. It was now just past sunset and there was very little visibility. It had long hair that hung down over its shoulders, but I could still see the shoulders stick out. It had its legs next to each other, and either closed, or it was wearing a dress. I felt that maybe I imagined it, but it just kept pulling me to its attention. When my partner made a comment about the hungry mosquitoes, I looked up at him, and when I looked back at where I saw the being, it was gone.

We didn't get to see anything white. Nothing that was moving that we could see, really. It was a pretty calm evening though.

The last things that were happening, were that suddenly my partner got thoughts about foxes and he couldn't shake it out of his mind. Then he got the thought "you're going to hear a fox", which he thought was just silly all over. Until a fox started barking. You can't mistake that sound. Anyway, we heard the fox come closer and then bend off around the crossroads, making sounds at times as if to let us know where it was.

It had become pretty late already, and we decided to go on back. I told my partner I was a bit bummed out about not seeing anything as clearly after having seen the person watching me from up close as I hung the ribbons. And just as I was done speaking, I saw a pale woman's arm out of nowhere, moving like as if dancing, and as the hand curved up towards a shoulder, the whole arm was gone again.

Anyway, that was that. Nothing much happened, but we did get the thoughts from time to time that since we came to watch "them", they would now watch us too in turn. And other times "you look right at me but you cannot see me". Pretty eerie, but also exciting since we've still not figured out what exactly is going on. The only thing we could settle on, is that it's absolutely mindgames. Beings that can choose whether or not you see them, manipulating that, and able to communicate telepathically? That's putting "seeing fairies" into entirely different light. My guess is that they can choose how they want to be seen, perhaps to be able to manipulate passersby better.
